summary: Specifies how authors of Independent Submission RFCs grant the community the rights to copy and use their text, and what rights the community grants to readers in return. It asks the IETF Trust to manage the rights. It is informational.

eli5.summary: When you write something for everyone to read, you need to say what others may do with it. This document sets those copying rules for independent RFC authors.

questions: who owns the copyright for independent submission rfcs
what are the rights rules for independent rfcs
